2610.08246.title: LeanPlan: Optimal Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics and Admissibility Proofs
2610.08246.paper_summary: Frontier large language models (LLMs) can generate heuristic functions that guide search to achieve state-of-the-art performance in satisficing planning, where any plan is acceptable. However, these heuristics are not guaranteed to be admissible and can lead to suboptimal plans. We introduce LeanPlan, the first planning system that finds optimal plans with LLM-generated heuristics whose admissibility is machine-checked. Given a domain description and training tasks, an agentic loop uses planner feedback to iteratively improve a reusable domain-specific heuristic, its admissibility proof and the required domain assumptions. LeanPlan implements the heuristic, its proof and an efficient planner with machine-checked grounding and search in Lean 4. We evaluate LeanPlan on ten domains from the International Planning Competition and three new domains, using test tasks with up to 57 times as many objects as the training tasks. With GPT-5.6 Sol in the agentic loop, we successfully generate heuristics and admissibility proofs for all these domains. With the resulting heuristics, LeanPlan usually expands fewer states than the state-of-the-art Scorpion planner and solves more tasks overall.
2610.08246.paper_summary_zh: 邊界大型語言模型（LLMs）可以生成啟發式函數，指導搜索以實現滿意規劃中的最先進性能，在這種情況下，任何計劃都是可接受的。<lb/>然而，這些啟發式函數並不保證是可接受的，並且可能導致次優計劃。<lb/>我們介紹了LeanPlan，第一個使用LLM生成的啟發式函數來找到最佳計劃的規劃系統，其可接受性由機器檢查。<lb/>給定一個領域描述和訓練任務，代理循環使用規劃者的反饋來迭代改進可重用的領域特定啟發式函數、其可接受性證明和所需的領域假設。<lb/>LeanPlan實現了啟發式函數、其證明以及一個高效的規劃器，並在Lean 4中進行了機器檢查的基礎和搜索。<lb/>我們在國際規劃競賽的十個領域和三個新領域上評估了LeanPlan，使用的測試任務的物體數量是訓練任務的57倍。<lb/>在代理循環中使用GPT-5.6 Sol，我們成功生成了所有這些領域的啟發式函數和可接受性證明。<lb/>使用生成的啟發式函數，LeanPlan通常擴展的狀態數量少於最先進的Scorpion規劃器，並且總體上解決了更多任務。
